name: revyl
description: Run your mobile app on cloud iOS and Android devices, verify changes with AI checks, and explore its Atlas screen map
shortDescription: Cloud mobile devices and AI app testing

setup.notice: Requires a Revyl account. The bundled skills build and run apps with the Revyl CLI, which signs in separately from this connection.
steps: For sessions nobody watches, save a Revyl API key as a REVYL_API_KEY secret so the CLI can sign in without an approval link
